title: Vision Benefit Allowances and Copayments by Rider
content:
Vision terms carried by the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders.

| Rider | Routine eye examination copayment (USD) | Routine eye examinations in a benefit year | Frame allowance (USD) | Months before frames are paid for again | Lens allowance (USD) | Contact lens allowance (USD) | Lens enhancements covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 10.00 | 1 | 175.00 | 24 | 150.00 | 160.00 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 10.00 | 1 | 250.00 | 12 | 200.00 | 220.00 | yes |

## What each term means

**Routine eye examination copayment.** What the member pays for a routine eye examination, in USD.

**Routine eye examinations in a benefit year.** How many routine eye examinations the rider pays for in a benefit year.

**Frame allowance.** The most the rider pays toward eyeglass frames, in USD.

**Months before frames are paid for again.** The months that must pass before frames are paid for again.

**Lens allowance.** The most the rider pays toward a pair of standard spectacle lenses, in USD.

**Contact lens allowance.** The most the rider pays toward contact lenses instead of spectacles, in USD.

**Lens enhancements covered.** Whether lens enhancements such as anti-reflective coating are covered.

## Reading the schedule

Two riders carry vision terms: the Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider. The four dental and hearing riders carry 0.00 USD and a count of 0 on every vision term, and cover no lens enhancement.

Where both vision-bearing riders carry a term, the bundle rider carries the larger allowance and the shorter interval: 250.00 USD against 175.00 USD on frames, 200.00 USD against 150.00 USD on lenses, 220.00 USD against 160.00 USD on contact lenses, and 12 months against 24 months before frames are paid for again. The routine eye examination copayment of 10.00 USD and the single examination a benefit year are the same on both.
